questions.question: When Job answered his friends, what big question did he ask about the wicked?

answers.text: Why do the wicked live on
Why do the wicked never rest
Why do the wicked fear death

questions.question: Job told his friends that the wicked go down to Sheol in terror. True or false?
Job said the wicked ask what they would gain if they prayed to the Almighty. True or false?
In Job's complaint about the wicked, how is an evil man treated when he dies?

answers.text: He is carried to the grave and his tomb is watched
He is thrown outside the city and left unburied
He is buried in a hurry and quickly forgotten
